limitations: Direct visual review covers these 16 exact screenshots, not full application accessibility or every possible placement.
At 800 by 400 the host country strip already obstructs globe controls without the shown companion; the regression only establishes that Booky adds no obstruction to the sampled baseline targets.
Companion controls can cover noninteractive zoom information and ordinary book text or cover content. Open tips intentionally overlay underlying content and some controls.
Walking and target-approach captures show individual frames only; duration, interruption, canonical scene retention and preference invariants rely on the accompanying browser assertions.
No installed-device, iOS, child, editorial, legal, art-acceptance or release approval is inferred.
